route_note: Take the RTD FF1/Flatiron Flyer bus from downtown Denver Union Station or Boulder-bound stops directly to downtown Boulder in about an hour; no rail connection exists.
RTD W Line light rail runs from downtown Denver to Golden station, with a short walk or local bus to the historic downtown and Clear Creek.
tour_query: Golden Colorado day trip from Denver

route_note: Take the RTD BUSTANG or CDOT Bustang West Line from Denver Union Station to Idaho Springs, about 45-60 minutes on I-70.
tour_query: Idaho Springs day trip from Denver

route_note: CDOT Bustang West Line stops in Georgetown from Denver Union Station; the historic loop railroad is a short walk from the stop.
tour_query: Georgetown Loop Railroad day trip from Denver

route_note: Take the Bustang or Estes Park Shuttle from Denver Union Station to Estes Park, then use the local trolley or park shuttle into Rocky Mountain National Park.
tour_query: Rocky Mountain National Park day trip from Denver
